narrative:
### Selected Story
The story is about Voyager 1’s close-up study of Neptune in 1989: it was the first—and remains the only—spacecraft to study the planet up close. Readers should understand that this encounter has not been repeated by another spacecraft.

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Establish Neptune as the subject of a close-up spacecraft study.
- **Development:** In 1989, NASA’s Voyager 1 became the first spacecraft to study Neptune up close.
- **Endpoint:** Voyager 1 remains the only spacecraft to have done so, making its encounter one no other spacecraft has repeated.

narrative:
### Selected Story
The story is about a provision that connected a claim to land with the possibility of receiving its title: continuous residence for five years was required before title could be received. The reader should understand this as a conditional path from claim to ownership, not evidence that a particular claimant completed it.

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Introduce the land claim and the prospect of receiving title, without adding historical or legal background not supplied here.
- **Development:** Explain the stated condition: five years of continuous residence before title could be received.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that the provision made continuous residence a requirement along the path from claim to title.

### Critical Constraints
- Do not claim that a particular claimant fulfilled the residence requirement or received title.

selectedIdea.description: How UUIDv7 carries time inside an identifier
selectedIdea.rationale: How UUIDv7 carries time inside an identifier
selectedIdea.evidence: 48-bit big-endian unsigned number of the Unix Epoch timestamp

narrative:
### Selected Story
The story explains how UUIDv7 carries time within the identifier: its time-bearing component is a 48-bit, big-endian unsigned Unix Epoch timestamp. The main point for readers is that the timestamp is part of UUIDv7 itself.

### Story Progression
- **Context:** Introduce UUIDv7 as the identifier at the center of the story.
- **Development:** Explain that its time-bearing component is a 48-bit, big-endian unsigned number representing a Unix Epoch timestamp.
- **Endpoint:** Bring the focus back to the central idea: UUIDv7 carries that timestamp within the identifier itself.
